  </head>
  <body class="h-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#0c0f13] text-slate-200">
    <!-- Top Instrument Chassis Header & File Tabs -->
    <header class="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#0c0f13] border-b border-[#222933] px-3 h-10 shrink-0 gap-2">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 overflow-x-auto min-w-0">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-xs tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-100 shrink-0">
          <svg class="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
            <polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"></polyline>
          </svg>
          <span>Waveform Viewer Pro</span>
        </div>
        <div class="h-4 w-px bg-[#222933] shrink-0"></div>
        <div id="tabsContainer" class="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 text-xs">
        <button id="loadBtn" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 font-semibold rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Open CSV, WFM, LTspice .raw/.txt, or .graphx session">
          <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h5l2 3h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path></svg>
          Open File
        </button>
        <input type="file" id="fileInput" class="hidden" accept=".csv,.wfm,.raw,.graphx,.txt" multiple />

        <!-- LTspice Live Watch Strip -->
        <div class="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#161b22] border border-[#222933] rounded-sm px-1.5 py-0.5">
          <button id="watchLtspiceBtn" type="button" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-cyan-300 font-medium rounded-xs transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Watch an LTspice .raw / .txt / .csv file and auto-reload when simulation reruns">
            LTspice Watch
          </button>
          <button id="reloadLtspiceBtn" type="button" class="hidden px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-[#0c0f13] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 font-mono rounded-xs transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Force reload watched LTspice file now">
            ↻ Reload
          </button>
          <label id="ltspiceAutoWrap" class="hidden items-center gap-1 pl-1 text-[11px] text-slate-300 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Automatically reload canvas when LTspice finishes a new run">
            <input type="checkbox" id="autoLtspiceChk" class="accent-cyan-400 cursor-pointer" checked />
            <span>Auto</span>
          </label>
          <span id="ltspiceWatchBadge" class="hidden px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 font-mono text-[10px] rounded-xs whitespace-nowrap">LIVE</span>
        </div>

        <button id="loadSampleSignalBtn" class="px-2 py-1 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-200 rounded-sm border border-[#222933] transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Load synthetic 3-phase BLDC motor waveform">
          Demo 3-Ph
        </button>

        <div class="h-4 w-px bg-[#222933] mx-0.5"></div>

        <!-- Theme Selector -->
        <select id="themeSelect" class="px-2 py-1 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium cursor-pointer" title="Switch Oscilloscope Color Theme">
          <option value="obsidian">Obsidian Scope</option>
          <option value="midnight">Midnight Slate</option>
          <option value="daylight">Daylight Lab</option>
        </select>

        <!-- Tools Click Dropdown -->
        <div class="relative wvp-dropdown">
          <button type="button" class="wvp-dropdown-trigger px-2 py-1 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 rounded-sm flex items-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap">
            <span>Tools</span>
            <svg class="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline></svg>
          </button>
          <div class="wvp-dropdown-menu absolute right-0 top-full mt-1 hidden flex-col z-50 min-w-[175px] rounded-sm py-1">
            <button id="openBatchModalBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Batch Measure...</button>
            <button id="openPresetModalBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Analysis Presets...</button>
            <button id="testSuiteBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-emerald-400 cursor-pointer">Algorithm Self-Test</button>
            <div class="my-1 border-t border-[#222933]"></div>
            <button id="openShortcutsModalBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-300 font-mono cursor-pointer">Shortcuts (?)</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Export Click Dropdown -->
        <div class="relative wvp-dropdown">
          <button type="button" class="wvp-dropdown-trigger px-2 py-1 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 rounded-sm flex items-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap">
            <span>Export</span>
            <svg class="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline></svg>
          </button>
          <div class="wvp-dropdown-menu absolute right-0 top-full mt-1 hidden flex-col z-50 min-w-[205px] rounded-sm py-1">
            <button id="exportPngBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">PNG Screenshot (Ctrl+S)</button>
            <button id="exportReportHtmlBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-emerald-300 cursor-pointer">Test Report (HTML / PDF)</button>
            <button id="exportSvgBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">SVG Vector Plot</button>
            <button id="exportCsvWaveformBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Full Waveform CSV</button>
            <button id="openCropExportMenuBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-cyan-300 cursor-pointer">Crop Slice CSV / JSON...</button>
            <button id="exportCsvSpectrumBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Spectrum CSV</button>
            <div class="my-1 border-t border-[#222933]"></div>
            <button id="saveSessionBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Save Session (.graphx)</button>
            <button id="exportStandaloneHtmlBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-cyan-300 font-semibold cursor-pointer">Offline App (.html)</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button id="togglePanelBtn" class="px-2 py-1 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-300 rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Toggle right oscilloscope control panel">
          Hide Panel
        </button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Main Oscilloscope Chassis Body -->
    <main class="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden min-h-0">
      <!-- Left/Center Oscilloscope Screen Bay -->
      <section class="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 bg-[#080b0f] relative">
        <!-- Top Screen Telemetry & Scope Toolbar (2 compact non-overflowing rows) -->
        <div class="bg-[#12161c] border-b border-[#222933] px-3 py-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1.5 shrink-0 text-xs">
          <!-- Row 1: Horizontal Timebase, Trigger & Rendering Modes -->
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <div class="flex items-center bg-[#0c0f13] border border-[#222933] rounded-sm overflow-hidden">
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#161b22] text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-slate-400 border-r border-[#222933]">H</span>
                <button id="timebaseDecBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-200 font-mono cursor-pointer" title="Zoom in timebase (smaller s/div)">−</button>
                <span id="timebaseReadout" class="px-2 py-0.5 font-mono font-semibold text-amber-300 tabular-nums min-w-[84px] text-center">-- /div</span>
                <button id="timebaseIncBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-200 font-mono cursor-pointer" title="Zoom out timebase (larger s/div)">+</button>
              </div>

              <div class="flex items-center bg-[#0c0f13] border border-[#222933] rounded-sm overflow-hidden">
                <button id="panLeftBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-300 font-mono cursor-pointer" title="Pan left 1 division">◀</button>
                <button id="panRightBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-300 font-mono border-l border-[#222933] cursor-pointer" title="Pan right 1 division">▶</button>
              </div>

              <div class="hidden xl:flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#0c0f13] border border-[#222933] rounded-sm font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-300 tabular-nums">
                <span id="acqSampleRateReadout">-- Sa/s</span>
                <span class="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span id="acqDepthReadout">0 pts</span>
              </div>

              <button id="triggerQuickBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#0c0f13] hover:bg-[#161b22] border border-[#222933] rounded-sm font-mono text-[11px] text-orange-300 tabular-nums cursor-pointer" title="Open Trigger Configuration">
                TRIG: OFF
              </button>
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <!-- Waveform / FFT / XY Segmented Toggle -->
              <div class="flex bg-[#0c0f13] p-0.5 border border-[#222933] rounded-sm">
                <button id="timeModeBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm bg-cyan-600 text-slate-950 font-semibold transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap">
                  Time
                </button>
                <button id="freqModeBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap">
                  FFT
                </button>
                <button id="xyModeBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Lissajous XY Phase / Trajectory Plot">
                  XY
                </button>
              </div>

              <!-- Overlap / Separate Segmented Toggle -->
              <div class="flex bg-[#0c0f13] p-0.5 border border-[#222933] rounded-sm">
                <button id="overlapViewBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm bg-[#222933] text-white font-medium transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Overlay all active channels on shared grid">
                  Overlap
                </button>
                <button id="separateViewBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Stack each channel in its own dedicated subplot & Y-axis">
                  Separate
                </button>
              </div>

              <!-- Render Mode 4-Way Switch (Vector | Sin(x)/x | Dots | V+M) -->
              <div class="flex bg-[#0c0f13] p-0.5 border border-[#222933] rounded-sm font-mono text-[11px]" title="Waveform Trace Display Mode">
                <button id="renderModeVectorBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm bg-[#222933] text-white font-medium transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Continuous Straight Vector Lines">Vector</button>
                <button id="renderModeSincBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Smooth Sin(x)/x Curve Interpolation for Low-Sample-Rate Waveforms">Sin(x)/x</button>
                <button id="renderModeDotsBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Sample Dots Only">Dots</button>
                <button id="renderModeMarkersBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Vector Line + Sample Markers">V+M</button>
              </div>

              <!-- Decimator Mode Toggle (>10k points) -->
              <div class="flex bg-[#0c0f13] p-0.5 border border-[#222933] rounded-sm font-mono text-[10px]" title="Large-dataset (>10k pts) decimation algorithm">
                <button id="decimMinMaxBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm bg-[#222933] text-cyan-300 font-medium transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Min-Max Peak Hold (preserves narrow glitches)">MinMax</button>
                <button id="decimLttbBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Largest-Triangle-Three-Buckets (LTTB)">LTTB</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Row 2: Clean Neutral Scope Actions + Analyze Menu -->
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-[#1b212a]">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <button id="openMeasureModalBtn" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 font-medium rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Select automated oscilloscope measurements">
                <span>Measure</span>
                <span id="measureCountLabel" class="px-1 bg-[#0c0f13] border border-[#222933] font-mono text-[10px] text-cyan-300 tabular-nums">0</span>
              </button>
              <button id="openCompareModalBtn" class="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 font-medium rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Compare waveforms across files, tabs, or channels">
                Compare
              </button>
              <button id="openThermalModalBtn" class="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-[#132229] hover:bg-[#19303a] border border-cyan-600/60 text-cyan-200 font-medium rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="MOS Electro-Thermal Deconvolution, LTspice Cauer Netlist, Closed-Loop Tj(t) & Dynamic SOA">
                MOS Thermal
              </button>

              <!-- Unified Analyze Dropdown -->
              <div class="relative wvp-dropdown">
                <button type="button" class="wvp-dropdown-trigger px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 font-medium rounded-sm flex items-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap">
                  <span>Analyze</span>
                  <svg class="w-3 h-3" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline></svg>
                </button>
                <div class="wvp-dropdown-menu absolute left-0 top-full mt-1 hidden flex-col z-50 min-w-[215px] rounded-sm py-1">
                  <button id="openThermalAnalyzeBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-cyan-300 font-medium cursor-pointer">MOS Thermal & SOA Workbench...</button>
                  <button id="openBldcModalBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">BLDC Diagnostics...</button>
                  <button id="openPhaseModalBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Phase Diff ΔΦ...</button>
                  <button id="openAnomalyModalBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Anomaly Scan...</button>
                  <button id="openEditModalBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Edit / Golden Ref...</button>
                  <div class="my-1 border-t border-[#222933]"></div>
                  <button id="transformBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">3-Phase / Power Math...</button>
                  <button id="motorBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Motor / RPM Estimator...</button>
                  <button id="openCropExportBtn" class="text-left px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-xs text-slate-200 cursor-pointer">Crop Slice Export...</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <button id="syncUnitScaleBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#162229] hover:bg-[#1d303a] border border-cyan-600/60 text-cyan-200 font-medium rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Unify V/div, ground & offset for all same-unit channels driven by the largest trace (Shortcut: U)">
                Sync Unit (U)
              </button>
              <button id="autoSetBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#1a222d] hover:bg-[#243040] border border-[#2c3849] text-emerald-300 font-semibold rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="AutoSet 1-2-5 scales & trigger (Shortcut: A)">
                AutoSet
              </button>
              <button id="fitViewBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Fit all signals (F / Esc / Double-Click)">
                Fit
              </button>
              <button id="toolZoomBtn" class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-[#161b22] hover:bg-[#1e2530] border border-[#222933] text-slate-200 rounded-sm transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap" title="Area Box Zoom (Z or Right-Drag)">
                Zoom
              </button>

              <div class="flex items-center bg-[#0c0f13] border border-[#222933] rounded-sm overflow-hidden">
                <button id="undoBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-300 text-[11px] cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40" title="Undo (Ctrl+Z)">↶</button>
                <button id="redoBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-300 text-[11px] border-l border-[#222933] cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40" title="Redo (Ctrl+Y)">↷</button>
              </div>

              <!-- Annotation Tools -->
              <div class="flex items-center bg-[#0c0f13] border border-[#222933] rounded-sm overflow-hidden">
                <button id="toolPointBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-300 text-[11px] cursor-pointer" title="Point Measurement Annotation">Pt</button>
                <button id="toolTextBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-300 text-[11px] border-l border-[#222933] cursor-pointer" title="Text Callout Annotation">Txt</button>
                <button id="toolAreaBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 hover:bg-[#1e2530] text-slate-300 text-[11px] border-l border-[#222933] cursor-pointer" title="Box ΔT / ΔV Area Annotation">Box</button>
                <button id="clearAnnBtn" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 hover:bg-red-950/60 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-300 text-[11px] border-l border-[#222933] cursor-pointer" title="Clear all annotations">Clr</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Graticule Canvas Container -->
        <div class="flex-1 relative overflow-hidden min-h-0">
          <canvas id="waveformCanvas" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full cursor-crosshair"></canvas>

          <!-- Empty State Overlay (hidden once data is loaded) -->
          <div id="emptyScopeOverlay" class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
            <div class="bg-[#12161c]/95 border border-[#222933] p-6 max-w-md text-center rounded-sm pointer-events-auto shadow-2xl">
